title: A last use makes room for mutation
purpose: A shared read ends before an exclusive write. A subsequent shared view observes the updated owner.
contract: Before: A[1,2] = 6; exclusive write sets it to 60; after: A[1,2] = 60
Rust checks borrow use, not merely the position of closing braces
A cloned owner has separate element storage; a cloned view retains its borrow
